updates.text: Kreiter kept the punt operation clean against the controlled rush. The late interior A-gap exchange was a protection correction, not an attributed bad snap. Both snapping orders held August 1; neither snapper separated.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Casey Kreiter, an undrafted rookie from Iowa signed to compete with Jeremy Cain, was the long snapper Jacksonville kept at the final roster cut, and he has handled {{2014.regular.long_snaps}} long snaps in {{2014.regular.games:words}} games in 2014. He arrived after four seasons of Big Ten snapping with technique and snap accuracy as his best tools, and in camp he kept the punt operation clean against a controlled rush. Athleticism, speed and change of direction are his main limitations, and the staff judged every part of his game below an NFL starter's standard when he signed.

transactions.text: Signed a three-year contract with Jacksonville as an undrafted rookie
